shots.alt: Combat encounter modal showing the player ship, attacking pirate, route, and available choices
shots.label: Encounter
shots.title: Pending encounter modal
shots.text: Manual ships pause on the encounter modal until the player chooses fight, flee, or bribe.

shots.alt: Encounter action cards showing Fight, Flee, and Bribe with odds bands and a recommended action
shots.label: Choices
shots.title: Fight, flee, and bribe cards
shots.text: Each action shows a fuzzy odds band and marks the auto-pilot recommendation when one choice is clearly favored.

shots.alt: Encounter action cards showing cargo, credit, and hull loss pills
shots.label: Losses
shots.title: Concrete loss pills
shots.text: Loss pills name the exact cargo, credits, or hull damage at stake before the player commits.

shots.alt: Ledger Combat tab showing encounter history with choices, outcomes, attackers, routes, and losses
shots.label: Ledger
shots.title: Combat history feed
shots.text: Ledger records encounter choices, outcomes, attackers, routes, and losses for player ships or all ships.

shots.alt: Atlas Logistics map showing lane danger, encounter pings, and active security news
shots.label: Atlas
shots.title: Lane danger and encounter pings
shots.text: Atlas Logistics mode turns recent encounter history into lane danger tint and fresh hostile-contact pings.
